name: Bloodpetal Sprouts
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText: Here goes nothing, adventurer! This will get Larion's attention!
narrative.requestItemsText:
Here's the plan, adventurer: Go out and collect some bloodpetal sprouts -- you know, the plants that haven't fully sprouted yet, and bring them here. Then I'll see what the Atal'ai haze can do.

You may think I'm vengeful... Actually, you'd be right about that!

Truth is, I know the way out of here, but until Larion will admit that I'm right, I'm staying right here!

So off with you, find those bloodpetal sprouts and let's have some fun!

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 52 to 53, 17,950 XP in all.

quests.name: Muigin and Larion
quests.objectiveText: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.

quests.name: A Visit to Gregan
quests.objectiveText: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.

quests.name: Haze of Evil
quests.objectiveText: Collect 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze, then return to Muigin in Un'Goro Crater.
